mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.author_id, t.target_type, t.target_id, t.amount, t.message, t.status, t.pay_method, t.paid_time, t.created_time, pu.nickname AS author_nickname, pu.avatar AS author_avatar FROM portal_tip_order t LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = t.author_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_time DESC

SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.author_id, t.target_type, t.target_id, t.amount, t.message, t.status, t.pay_method, t.paid_time, t.created_time, pu.nickname AS user_nickname, pu.avatar AS user_avatar FROM portal_tip_order t LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = t.user_id WHERE t.author_id = #{userId} ORDER BY t.created_time DESC

SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.author_id, t.target_type, t.target_id, t.amount, t.message, t.status, t.pay_method, t.paid_time, t.created_time, pu.nickname AS user_nickname, pu.avatar AS user_avatar FROM portal_tip_order t LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = t.user_id WHERE t.target_type = #{targetType} AND t.target_id = #{targetId} AND t.status = 'paid' ORDER BY t.paid_time DESC
